newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY UNION-ACT BEAT CANTERBURY 49-29 IN SUPER 12 MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ACT BEAT CANTERBURY 49-29 IN SUPER 12 MATCH.

text.p: Australian Capital Territory (ACT) beat Canterbury 49-29 (halftime 13-10) in a Super 12 match at Bruce Stadium on Saturday.
ACT - Tries: Ipolito Fenukitau (3), George Gregan, John Langford, Mitchell Hardy. Conversions: David Knox (5). Penalties: David Knox (2). Drop goal: David Knox.
Canterbury - Tries: Tabai Matson (2), James Kerr, Scott Robertson, Paula Bale. Conversions: Leon MacDonald (2).
